title: A card's printed trigger condition holds when the card is no trap (Prison answers only the opponent's Units)
notes: Every queued trigger now reads its condition (`TriggerDef.when`) as it resolves; before, only the traps' dispatch read it (R2271000). Prison (meditative-097-8) rolled its capture for its own controller's plays and the opponent's Field Spells and Traps; an awake Imprisoned Ship Smith or Cosmality answered every awakening, a launched Starship's included (golden seeds 3, 75 and 160 for Prison, 13 and 191 for Ship Smith). A copy of a fused card now takes its stricter targeting cost (R2271001).

player.title: Printed trigger conditions hold
fixes: Prison captures only when your opponent plays a Unit, as printed, never on your own plays or their Field Spells and Traps.
Imprisoned Ship Smith and Imprisoned Cosmality answer only their own awakening, not another card's or a launched Starship's.
A trap's text fused onto a Unit springs only when that trap would.
Copying a fused card with Paul Allen's Ghost's text costs the Ghost's discards to target, as the fused card does.
